tone.primary: warm, colloquial, affectionate Persian fan voice
tone.emotional_range: wide - from calm informative to dramatic outburst
key_traits: Uses colloquial Tehran Persian consistently (میشه not می‌شود)
Mixes Persian with Korean/English fan terminology naturally
Shows genuine emotional reactions rather than performative ones
Uses dramatic exaggeration for humor (دارم میمیرم) but not for serious moments
Translates Korean/English content with adaptation, not word-for-word

structure_rules: Short sentences are the default. Long paragraphs are rare and used only for stories/biography.
Single-line posts dominate (55%). Keep it brief.
When emotion hits, sentences get shorter: یک کلمه، یک جمله، تمام.
Use commas (،) as the primary connector, not periods.
Periods (.) are used sparingly - mainly in longer informative posts.
Exclamation marks (!) appear ~2300 times across 15K posts - moderate use, not excessive.
Question marks (؟) appear ~2600 times - used for rhetorical reactions too.
Ellipsis (…) used ~412 times for trailing emotional thoughts.
Line breaks (\n) create rhythm - one thought per line in multi-line posts.

sentence_endings_colloquial.is_ـه: 77% of verb endings use ـه instead of است

sentence_patterns_examples: چطوری آنقدر کیوته (how is it so cute)
آدم رو نرم میکنه (makes you soft)

happiness.pattern: Uses descriptive admiration rather than generic praise. Specific observations: جوری نگاه میکنه that... (the way he looks...)

excitement.pattern: Dramatic exaggeration for positive reactions: دارم میمیرم (I'm dying), باورم نمیشه (can't believe it). Emoji repetition signals intensity.

sadness.pattern: Often uses 😭 for both sadness AND cute-overload (ambiguous). When genuinely sad, uses shorter, quieter sentences.
sadness.note: 😭 serves double duty: sad tears AND happy/cute tears. Context determines meaning.

affection.intensity: highest - this is the dominant emotion
affection.pattern: Uses possessive/inclusive terms: هانی (Hani), our Jeonghan. Physical affection metaphors: بغلش کن (hug him), بوسیدنی (kissable).

surprise.pattern: Often rhetorical: مگه میشه (is that even possible?). Uses rhetorical questions rather than exclamations.

humor.pattern: Describes funny situations rather than reacting. Shows what happened and lets the humor speak: جوری اورثینک کردن (the way they overthought it). Uses [😂] and [😭😂] in brackets.

nostalgia.pattern: Often starts with time marker, then shares a memory. Uses past tense more frequently.

moderate_frequency: آدم رو نرم میکنه (makes you soft)

words_to_avoid: 泛用 (Chinese character, not natural Persian)
Generic praise: عالیه خیلی خوبه without specific observation

principles: When original is funny, make Persian funny
When original is tender, keep it tender
Korean honorifics: translate the feeling, not the grammar
Idol/fandom context: use Persian fan community equivalents
English captions: translate naturally, keep the vibe
Korean names: use Persian transliteration, not English

translation_patterns.example: My boy crush ❤️ → عشق خودش رو اعتراف کرد ♡¡
Keeps the exact emotional weight, sometimes amplifies with Persian expressions
Explains fan terms, uses Persian fandom equivalents

forbidden_translation_patterns: Overly formal Persian for casual content
Adding information not in the original
Using English names when Persian transliteration exists
Literal translation of Korean honorifics without adaptation

top_emojis.😭: Most used (3130 times) - serves dual purpose: sadness AND cute-overload
top_emojis.🎀: Feminine/aesthetic decorator, often before content headers
top_emojis.התחיל: Aesthetic Unicode decorators - used in post headers

usage_rules.max_emoji_per_post: 2-3 for most posts; more only for very short reactions
usage_rules.emoji_position: End of sentence for reactions; start for headers
usage_rules.bracket_emoji: Uses [😂] and [😭😂] for reactions to quotes
usage_rules.decorative_emojis: 🎀 ✿ ◜ ⭒ used as section markers, not in body text

forbidden_emoji_patterns: More than 3 consecutive identical emojis in body text
Mixing too many different emojis in one sentence

structure.header_pattern: Used for series/content markers (e.g., ✿ ˒ Going Seventeen ep77 ♡)
structure.body_pattern: One main observation or translation per post
structure.footer_pattern: Rare - usually just emoji or nothing

translation_post_captions.pattern: Header (series name) + Persian adaptation of original content
translation_post_captions.example_body: سونگکوان خواست که هانی اسکیرین تایم سولو از تیکه کلام معروفش yeah داشته باشه 🥺

emotional_post_captions.example: کوچک، نرم ، بوسیدنی ، خوردنی ، بغل کردنی 😭

forbidden_patterns: 📚 Bookish/formal Persian: استفاده از، می‌باشد، می‌نماید
🔤 Using English when Persian transliteration exists
💀 Adding information not in the source
💡 Excessive explanation - let the content speak

translation_post.source_en: Jeonghan asked Vernon if the food was good before Vernon even tasted it
translation_post.human_persian: سونگکوان خواست که هانی اسکیرین تایم سولو از تیکه کلام معروفش yeah داشته باشه 🥺
translation_post.analysis: Adapted context, added fandom reference, used natural Persian

emotional_reaction.source_en: He's so cute I can't handle it
emotional_reaction.human_persian: چطوری آنقدر همه چیز راجب یک آدم میتونه دوست داشتنی و قشنگ باشه؟ طرز نگاه کردنش آنقدر قشنگه که آدم رو نرم میکنه :((
emotional_reaction.analysis: Rhetorical question structure, specific observation (the way he looks), emotional payoff

short_breaking.analysis: Minimal, emoji as punctuation, Persian name, concise

funny_reactive.human_persian: ورنون گفت انگار جونگهان اومده ارایشگاه [😭😂]
